issue.title: [ML] Data frame cannot be deleted if it was stopped while it was finishing

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`): 7.3.0 and 8.0.0

**Plugins installed**: ['repository-gcs']

**JVM version** (`java -version`): openjdk 11.0.2

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system): Darwin Kernel Version 18.6.0

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:
From Slack discussions:

> [Ben Trent]
> Getting an NPE in Lucene.
> The best we can tell it was added here: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/compare/63ee61dace5a6a...cb527c2ece0f65
> 
> What we are doing in data-frame is running a DBQ terms query against the `.data-frame-internal-1`. Anytime that DBQ is running, a new doc could be added to the index with that same term.
> 
> Unsure if this same thing happens in 7.3 or 7.2. We are still testing
> 
> [Henning Andersen]
> An educated guess is that it is the prune ID merge policy change that changed this. If you can reproduce this locally, it is easy to disable this at `InternalEngine:2180`, simply replace `new PrunePostingsMergePolicy(mergePolicy, IdFieldMapper.NAME)` with `mergePolicy`. Curious to know the result...
> The problems is likely the slice on `_id`, I think a null check is missing in `TermsSliceQuery` since we risk a segment with no `_id` now (but this is way beyond my knowledge)...

Based on investigations so far, it looks like this issue is caused by #40741.


**Steps to reproduce**:
 1. Create a data frame and start it
 2. Send a stop request while the data frame is finishing
 3. Try to delete the data frame
 4. Notice that the delete request fails with a 500, and the reason is an NPE.

rename.from: NPE in Lucene when running DeleteByQuery
rename.to: NPE in slice query when running DeleteByQuery

body:
Notice that the use of `_id` is explicitly mentioned on the scroll search reference docs here:

https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/search-request-scroll.html

I think those would be affected too?

> I think those would be affected too?

Yes, the check should be implemented in the `_scroll` API since that's what all reindex commands use.
The default for `_scroll` is to not use any slicing but we should add a note in the documentation and a check in the code that `slice` are not used on indices that can remove the postings for the `_id` field.

issue.title: [ML][Data Frame] Removes slice specification from DBQ. See #42996

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Setting `slice` to a value that is not a multiple of the `shard` number can result in an NPE. This change removes our setting of a specific slice value. If performance gets hit hard enough, we will have to see about adjusting the slice to match a multiple of the shards. 

Relates to #42996

issue.title: [ML] Changes slice specification to auto. See #42996

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Changes from specifying the slice size to a static 5, to `auto` which will dynamically choose the appropriate number of slices given the number of shards. 

Relates to #42996
